label: merges results from
type: the subject alias fans a query out to each of the object indexes and merges their results into one result set. Minted for search:index-aliases, round 22; promoted this round on its second independent attestation.
evidence: The Search Service runs the Search query on each Search index in the alias, and returns a merged set of results.
An index alias points to one or more Full Text Indexes or to additional aliases.
relates_to_competency_question: When a query targets an alias spanning several indexes, does it run against each and merge the results, or pick one?
